entry_invariant: Any conversation entering an Enterprise Math RESEARCHER or RESEARCH_DRIVER role must resolve or allocate a Researcher-ID before substantive work begins.
entry_events: resume of an existing Enterprise Math conversation
resolution_order: reuse the Researcher-ID already visible in the current conversation if one exists
reuse an unambiguous persisted Researcher-ID bound to this same conversation/session if available
for scheduler CLAIM, derive a deterministic ID from task identity lane plus claim_id
otherwise generate a new short-code ID locally and persist it in the current conversation

lane_resolution.fallback: derive the compact Rxxx/Pxxx lane from task_id; otherwise use DIRECT

scheduler_claim.derivation: SHA-256(task_id + NUL + claim_id), uppercase first 6 hex characters, prefixed by EM-<LANE>-

role_transition.same_conversation: preserve Researcher-ID and update Research-Role / Research-Task metadata
role_transition.primary_driver: EM-DRIVER-01 only when the conversation is explicitly the primary Driver continuity conversation

taskbook_contract.rule: Taskbooks declare the identity policy/lane, never a fixed researcher instance ID. The executing conversation resolves or allocates its own Researcher-ID at runtime.
taskbook_contract.legacy_taskbooks: inherit this state machine even when the field is absent

registration.registration_failure: REGISTER_PENDING; continue research and persist the ID visibly; retry only at a semantic checkpoint
